verdict.rationale: The evidence covers the submission side: SmartScan captures receipt data automatically, expenses can be created, approved and rejected, and users praise Expensify for tracking their own expenses. Nothing in the pack mentions reimbursement payouts, direct deposit, payout timing, or status tracking through to payment, which are the core of this story. Missing for 10: direct-deposit reimbursement, evidence of payout within days, end-to-end tracking from submission to payout, and independent corroboration of reimbursement speed.
